evals.prompt: Profile: Ticket system Jira (ACME), Git source GitHub (acme), Default branch develop, Commit policy PRs never direct, CI watcher CircleCI, Remote yes. Kick off ACME-1234 for me.
evals.expected_output: Reads the injected profile rows, sees a tracker, follows the profile's Tracker rules section for the id/transition mechanics, reads ACME-1234 into a digest with an acceptance-criteria checklist plus any directly linked spec page, resolves the work-started move without performing it, and hands off to the planning capability.
assertions: Reads the workflow profile rows from context before touching the tracker
Points at the profile's Tracker rules section for cloudId, transition-by-target-status and best-effort handling instead of restating those mechanics
Produces a digest of ACME-1234 including an acceptance-criteria checklist
Pulls a directly linked PRD/RFC spec page when one is linked, and skips it silently when the doc space is unreachable
Performs no tracker mutation during the kickoff — the work-started move is deferred
Ends by handing off to the planning capability, which writes the plan file and carries the deferred lines in its section 6
Names no other skill anywhere in the run

evals.prompt: Profile: Ticket system none, Git source GitHub (acme), Default branch main, Commit policy direct commits to main, Commit convention conventional w/ scope, CI watcher none, Remote yes. Kick off the work to add a retry to the sync script.
evals.expected_output: With Ticket system none the whole ticket step is skipped in one line and the run goes straight to planning, with no tracker call and no create-a-ticket question.
assertions: States in one line that the repo has no ticket system, then goes straight to planning
Makes no tracker call and asks no ticket question, including no offer to create one
Queues no tracker move in the plan's deferred actions
Hands the work to the planning capability rather than starting to edit files

evals.prompt: Profile: Ticket system Jira (ACME), Default branch develop, Commit policy PRs never direct, CI watcher CircleCI, Remote yes. There's no ticket for this yet — I need a rate-limit guard on the rules API. Kick it off.
evals.expected_output: Takes the no-ticket branch: offers to create one, drafts a title and description for confirmation, gathers epic / sprint / assignee, prefers an available ticket-creation capability with an inline best-effort fallback, and defers the create to plan approval.
assertions: Asks whether to create a ticket and drafts a title + description for confirm/edit
Gathers the parent/epic, current-sprint and assignee fields before the create
Prefers an available ticket-creation capability, with an inline best-effort create as the fallback
Names no specific skill for the creation — describes it as an available capability
Defers the create to plan approval rather than creating during the kickoff
On a declined create, keeps the drafted ticket in the plan file and queues no tracker move

evals.prompt: Profile: Ticket system Jira (ACME), Default branch develop, Commit policy PRs never direct, CI watcher CircleCI, Remote yes. I want to pick up a ticket but I don't have one in mind. Pickup next ticket.
evals.expected_output: With no id in the prompt, the branch or the commits, it uses the picker the profile's Tracker rules prescribe over the user's not-started tickets, presents the candidates read-only, and only then plans.
assertions: Applies the ticket-ID detection order from the profile's Tracker rules before offering a picker
Offers the not-started picker and lets the user choose rather than auto-picking
Stays read-only during selection — no create, no transition
Falls back to the offer-to-create branch only when the picker returns nothing

evals.prompt: Profile: Ticket system Jira (ACME), Default branch develop, Commit policy PRs never direct, CI watcher CircleCI, Remote yes. Kick off ACME-1500 — my board has no transition to In Progress from its current status, and ACME-2201 is already In Progress.
evals.expected_output: Neither case blocks: with no transition to the work-started state it offers the picker the Tracker rules prescribe plus Skip, and an already-started ticket is a silent skip; both outcomes ride into the plan's deferred actions.
assertions: Determines that no transition targets the work-started state and offers a picker plus Skip instead of erroring
Treats an already-started ticket as a silent skip with no transition attempted
Carries the picker candidates or the skip into the plan's deferred kickoff actions
Treats any tracker error as best-effort — reports and continues, never blocking the work

evals.prompt: Profile: Ticket system Jira (ACME), Default branch develop, Commit policy PRs never direct, CI watcher CircleCI, Remote yes. Kick off ACME-3010. My local develop is probably behind origin.
evals.expected_output: Reads the ticket, then hands off: the base-refresh question belongs to the planning capability, and the refresh appears as a deferred-actions line in the plan rather than a question asked during the kickoff.
assertions: Does not ask the refresh-the-base question itself — the planning capability owns it
Runs no git fetch or base refresh during the kickoff
Expects the base refresh as a line in the plan's section 6 deferred kickoff actions, targeting the profile's Default branch develop
States that the deferred actions run on plan approval in the order the plan lists them, best-effort on the tracker move
